units.title: Units
units.pickerTitle: Units for every value the viewer shows: labels, cards, charts, maps, tables and exports
units.moreTitle: Choose a unit for each quantity
units.overridesHint: Each quantity follows the preset unless you pick a unit of its own.
units.inLabels: Units (the same everywhere in the viewer):
units.preset.metricTitle: Metres and kilometres, km/h, m/s, °C, hPa, kilograms
units.preset.imperialTitle: Feet and miles, mph, feet a minute, °F, inHg, pounds
units.preset.aviationTitle: Feet, nautical miles, knots, feet a minute, °C, hPa, pounds
units.preset.nauticalTitle: Metres, nautical miles, knots, m/s, °C, hPa, tonnes
units.look.fovHint: Horizontal field of view of the cones drawn from each player's eyes; 0 draws only the line of sight.
units.look.conesTitle: A view cone from each player's eyes along their view angles (with the team panel's look direction on)
units.look.needsTeam: Turn on 'Show look direction' in the team panel to see them.
units.look.aimTitle: A dashed line along each turret's gun, where the data has turret angles
units.look.cameraTitle: The recording player's own camera, drawn as a camera with its field of view
units.look.throughTitle: Follow the recorded camera and look through it; pick another follow mode to leave
units.figures.title: Figures
units.figures.scaleHint: Times true size: 1 is the vehicle's real size.
units.buildings.title: Buildings
units.buildings.solidTitle: The level's buildings solid, in their own colours
units.buildings.seeThroughTitle: The buildings as see-through shells, as the heat views draw them, so what is inside shows
